import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n, m, r = map(int, data[:3])
    s = list(map(int, data[3:3+n]))
    b = list(map(int, data[3+n:3+n+m]))

    min_buy = min(s)
    max_sell = max(b)

    if max_sell <= min_buy:
        print(r)
        return

    shares = r // min_buy
    remaining = r % min_buy
    result = remaining + shares * max_sell
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
